findings.summary: On turn 17 the scorer penalized Birdlaw despite Dustox being its declared target, chose Croakatoa, and allowed Infestation to trap and eventually faint Croakatoa.

resolution.observed: v30 selected Birdlaw on Dustox; the corrected suffix won in six verified actions and preserved Croakatoa.

findings.observed_fact: Birdlaw was a certified-safe legal switch; the corrected suffix selected it and won in six actions.
findings.strategic_judgment: Reserve roles must be rewarded against their current declared target and penalized only for off-target use.
findings.next_test: Reset to clone 1 and run behavior hash 3d5f5813 from the identical opening; review before clone 2.

findings.summary: One-step safety did not price Infestation trap duration and residual damage, so Croakatoa was labeled safe before a four-turn attrition faint.
findings.observed_fact: Infestation plus repeated Venoshock exhausted Croakatoa after the selected entry action.
findings.strategic_judgment: Keep residual and multi-turn gaps visible in heuristic certificates; matchup-role selection now avoids this specific exposure.
